items.agent_meaning: Structure and rites as necessary framework for cultivation - provides shape and direction during development

partner_meaning.laozi: Structure useful when building, released when done - scaffolding removed once the building stands

items.agent_meaning: Yan Hui grief as lived example - weeping for loss without raging at Heaven or adding layers of suffering

partner_meaning.buddha: First arrow (pain) is unavoidable; second arrow (suffering about suffering) is optional - Confucius naturally practiced this

items.agent_meaning: The gentleman is not a vessel - knowledge that does not shape character and action is incomplete cultivation

partner_meaning.buddha: Right understanding leads to right action - knowledge without practice is mere accumulation
partner_meaning.laozi: Unlearning returns to simplicity - transformation means shedding, not adding
